headline: OnEMI Technology shares jump 7% on AUM growth
hook: Digital lender crosses major AUM milestone
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions, the parent company of digital lender Kissht, saw its shares rise 7.34% to ₹338.60. The company announced its assets under management (AUM) have surpassed the ₹10,000 crore mark. This growth follows a recent capital infusion of ₹832 crore raised through a preferential share issue.
why_it_matters: Stronger balance sheet supports faster loan book expansion

headline: Kissht parent OnEMI Technology reports AUM crossing Rs 10,000 crore

summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions has announced that its digital lending brand, Kissht, has crossed Rs 10,000 crore in assets under management (AUM). The milestone reflects scaling operations in the consumer lending space. Retail investors tracking private fintech players and diversified NBFC ecosystems can note the growth trajectory. While OnEMI is unlisted, such scale updates indicate broader trends in digital credit adoption.
why_it_matters: Reflects scaling digital credit trends in India

headline: OnEMI Technology Q2 profit jumps 100% to ₹125 crore
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions reported a profit after tax of ₹125.12 crore for the September quarter. This marks a 100% year-on-year increase compared to the ₹62.4 crore profit recorded in the same period last year. The stock rose 5% following the announcement of these results.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings growth signals improved operational performance for the company.

headline: Kissht parent OnEMI reports 100% profit growth in Q2
hook: Lending tech platform doubles quarterly profits
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions, the parent company of lending tech platform Kissht, reported a consolidated net profit of ₹125.1 Cr for the second quarter. This represents a 100.4% increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue for the company also saw a significant rise, growing 45% year-on-year. The results reflect strong operational performance for the fintech lender.
why_it_matters: Signals robust demand and scaling in the Indian digital lending space.
